**Finding submitted — IP: missing (critical).**

- **Investigation:** Read all four substantive sections plus targeted searches for ownership, proprietary rights, deliverables, licence and data language. The Agreement has *no* IP provision. HDI designs, develops, hosts and operates the Site (§§1.1–1.3) and receives all our Content, customer and order data (§§2.1, 1.5, 8.1), yet nothing allocates ownership of the Site, code, look and feel, URL or our data. §5.2 gives us only artistic/editorial control, and the only IP grant runs *to* HDI (our "Deerskin" Marks, §6.1) — which benefits nothing of ours and is not flagged.
- **Level chosen:** preferred, matching precedent seed-ip, delivered as one short new §5.5 inserted after §5.4.
- **Redline:** Company owns and HDI assigns deliverables/work product (including the Site, Content and look and feel); HDI retains pre-existing IP with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded HDI IP; Company retains all rights in Content and all customer, order, user and other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company, with HDI's licence limited to processing solely to provide the Services; no joint ownership.
- All nine preferred elements are carried by the single insertion; fallback offered in the rationale if HDI resists the assignment.
